title: World Monitor launches global live dashboard with #WorldMonitor #GlobalTracking #satellitedata
description: World Monitor launched a free global dashboard that tracks real-time events like military activity, trade routes, and natural disasters. The platform offers multiple layered views including live webcams, news broadcasts, and six thematic versions such as Tech, Finance, and a Happy Monitor focused on positive news. This tool provides comprehensive situational awareness using satellite data and live feeds, making it accessible for anyone interested in up-to-the-minute global developments. Integration with AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude enables deeper investigation and analysis. World Monitor represents a shift toward open, easily accessible surveillance and information synthesis tools that were previously limited to governments. It offers new opportunities for transparency, research, and real-time event monitoring across multiple sectors. #WorldMonitor #GlobalSurveillance #RealTimeData #SatelliteMonitoring #MilitaryActivity #TradeRoutes #NaturalDisasters #LiveNews #AIIntegration #TechDashboard #FinanceDashboard #PositiveNews #SituationalAwareness #OpenData #GlobalEvents
